caption: Cathedral of Santa Maria Assunta, Atri
composition: Pale stone cathedral and campanile crowning the Abruzzo ridge town above green valleys · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera looks across the rooftops of Atri to the Cathedral of Santa Maria Assunta standing at the center in the bright 14:28 afternoon sun. The pale stone cathedral and its tall spired campanile rise above the sea of terracotta roofs that spread left and right along the ridge, with green valleys falling away at the frame's edges. Distant blue mountains layer along the horizon under a clear sky, and the afternoon light warms every roof tile.
